retentionExportRpc.name: public.shared_inventory_iva_retention_period(uuid,text,text)
retentionExportRpc.mcpValidated: Exact signature resolved and definition inspected read-only.
observedBehavior: Filters confirmed purchase records with a positive stored withholding amount.
Hardcodes document type 01 and affected document 0 for every exported row.
Emits only legacy rate codes reducida_8/general_16 (8/16 percent).
Does not filter document_type before aggregation, so a retained credit/debit note can be emitted as document type 01 with affected document 0.
Calculates IVA and withheld amounts from taxable base, rate, and retention percentage instead of returning the stored vat_retention_amount for each row.

aggregateQuery: select status, document_type, count(*) as invoice_count, count(*) filter (where coalesce(vat_retention_amount,0) > 0) as positive_vat_retention_count, coalesce(sum(vat_retention_amount),0) as total_vat_retention, count(*) filter (where coalesce(vat_retention_amount,0) > 0 and nullif(btrim(vat_retention_receipt_number),'') is null) as positive_retention_without_receipt from public.shared_inventory_purchase_invoices group by status, document_type order by status, document_type
limits: The aggregate reports only the stored purchase-invoice retention columns in this connected project.
It does not prove the absence of separate retention documents or data in another environment.
No data or schema was changed by these queries.
